name: new_deck
description: Create a shuffled deck of playing cards. Returns deck_id and remaining count. Use deck_count to combine multiple decks (e.g., 2 for 104 cards).

count.description: Number of standard 52-card decks to combine and shuffle. Defaults to 1.

name: draw_cards
description: Draw cards from a deck. Returns card details (suit, value) and remaining count. Specify count to draw multiple cards at once.

deck_id.description: The deck ID returned by new_deck (e.g. "3p40paa87x90").

count.description: Number of cards to draw. Defaults to 1.

name: shuffle_deck
description: Reshuffle a deck and reset all drawn cards back in. Returns updated remaining card count.
